name: VINU public addLiquidityETH with caller-supplied router
summary: VINU.addLiquidityETH(router, to, pair) was public and took the router address from the caller, so the attacker passed a fake router, moved the token side of the pair at will, synced the reserves and swapped the whole ETH reserve out.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: VINU 0xF7ef0D57277ad6C2baBf87aB64bA61AbDd2590D2 created 2023-06-06T10:46:47Z by 0x42b9b986e14be1483ecf5f2af7f713f2c6558d75 - 19.8 minutes before the incident - and that deployer is not the attack sender 0x9748c854... nor its funder; the deployer's own tx list shows it deploying VINU and adding liquidity, i.e. a genuine (very fresh) launch that was exploited immediately. No EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (1,188 seconds). Loss ~$6K per the PoC header, taken in ETH.
